## Optional team notifications
Set the Webhook Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <EVENT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN>.
Publish before setting EVENT_WEBHOOK_URL in the app.
Choose ONE notification branch or wire independent subworkflows. Nodes are disabled until you add credentials. Delivery errors must fail this workflow so the outbox retries.

Delivery is at least once. event_id / Idempotency-Key is stable across retries. This starter does NOT promise exactly-once Slack/email delivery; add receiver-side deduplication for your destination. A crash after a send can cause a duplicate alert.

Never send the suggested first reply automatically. Approval and sending are separate human actions.
